commits.subject: Keep Redisson error tests compatible with 4.x

diagnoses.analysis: This is the aggregate required-status gate, not an independent implementation failure. The frozen reusable-pr-build.yml gate depends on test-latest-deps and runs exit 1 when that dependency is unsuccessful. The frozen evidence has one failing test-latest-deps matrix job; the candidate fixes its two PR-introduced Redisson compatibility errors. No workflow change or rerun recommendation is warranted.

The newly added shared Redisson regression tests compile against 3.7.2 but run against the frozen latest pin 4.8.0, which renamed ReturnType.INTEGER to LONG and removed RFuture.join(). These deterministic linkage errors recur across all six test attempts. The candidate uses the common ReturnType.VALUE (numeric RESP replies still decode to Long) and CompletionStage.toCompletableFuture().join(), waiting on the callback stage before asserting callback state. The shared fixture and integration tests compile; all seven helper tests pass. A standalone binary compatibility probe passes on 3.0.0, 3.7.2, 3.17.0 and 4.8.0. Exact integration execution was attempted but failed in @BeforeAll because this environment has no Docker, so no integration-test pass is claimed.
evidence: java.lang.NoSuchFieldError: Class org.redisson.api.RScript$ReturnType does not have member field 'org.redisson.api.RScript$ReturnType INTEGER'

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

Record Redis server-error prefixes as `error.type` on Redisson spans and database duration metrics, including errors mapped to dedicated exception subclasses, such as `OOM`.

Capture prefixes directly from RESP error replies before completion callbacks run. Preserve case and punctuation without an allowlist or length cap; client-side failures and replies without a captured prefix retain exception-class fallback.
metadata.title: Classify Redisson Redis server errors
